Q2-In salaah a women should she keep her feet together in Qiyaam or should the feet be apart a Mufti saheb said that "theres two Qouls(oppinion) one Qoul is that the feet should be together and one Qoul is that the feet should be apart", which is the rajeh Qoul? Question: Assalamualaikum Q1-Bakra Eid should it be celabrated 3 days or 1 day? Q2-In salaah a women should she keep her feet together in Qiyaam or should the feet be apart a Mufti saheb said that "theres two Qouls(oppinion) one Qoul is that the feet should be together and one Qoul is that the feet should be apart", which is the rajeh Qoul? Answer ID: 7863 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1930/1712=B/1429) (1) Eid-ul-Azha is celebrated on 10, 11, 12 of Dhul Hijja (2) She should keep a distance of 4 fingers between her feet. However, it is better to keep the feet closer. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
